item.title: ＮＹ市場サマリー（4日）ダウ1500ドル超高、ドル下落 利回り低下
item.description: ＜為替＞ ドルが序盤の安値からは持ち直したものの、下落して取引を終えた。米中間選挙で民主党が圧勝し、市場の不透明感が後退...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＮＹ市場サマリー（4日）ダウ1500ドル超高、ドル下落　利回り低下 6:59 配信

＜為替＞ ドルが序盤の安値からは持ち直したものの、下落して取引を終えた。米中間選挙で民主党が圧勝し、市場の不透明感が後退した。

３日投開票の米中間選挙で、民主党が上下両院の過半数を奪還した。不人気な対イラン戦争への強い不満や生活費高騰への不安、トランプ氏の政権運営に対する怒りを背景に、有権者がトランプ大統領に厳しい審判を下した形となった。

主要通貨に対するドル指数は０．２５％安の１０１．６０。取引序盤で、９月３０日以来の安値となる１０１．２１まで下げる場面もあった。

ドルは対円で０．１４％安の１５８．４３円。

ユーロは０．２１％高の１．１２１７ドル。

ＮＹ外為市場：[USD/J]

＜債券＞ 不安定な値動きの中、 国債利回りが低下した。中間選挙で民主党が上下両院の支配権を掌握したことを受け、中東和平への期待から原油価格が急落した。議会とトランプ米大統領政権の間でねじれが生じる可能性も意識された。

投資家は、対イラン戦争を巡る米政府の次の一手を見極めようとする中、原油価格が９％超下落したことを受け、米国債を買い進めた。トランプ大統領は４日、対イラン戦争が共和党の中間選挙での敗北の一因になったと認めながらも、戦争には価値があったとの考えを示した。

１０年債利回りは５．２ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）低下の４．８９８％。一時、４．９６４２％まで上昇していた。

３０年債利回りは３．４ｂｐ低下の５．２９％。一時、１０月２９日以来の高水準となる５．３４４８％を付けた。

金利動向に敏感な２年債利回りは３．５ｂｐ低下の４．５７９％。一時、９月１０日以来の低水準となる４．５４５８％まで低下していた。

米金融・債券市場：[US/BJ]

＜株式＞ 大幅高で取引を終えた。中間選挙で民主党が圧勝し、政治的不透明感が後退したことでリスク選好が強まった。一方、人工知能（ＡＩ）規制が強化されるとの懸念から、データセンター関連株は下落した。

一部の大型ハイテク株は、ＡＩインフラの拡大鈍化が競争上有利になるとの見方から上昇した。一方、ＡＩインフラ整備の一端を担う比較的小規模な企業は、拡大鈍化が財務を圧迫するとの懸念から下落した。議会の勢力図の変化によってイラン戦争の終結が早まるとの観測から原油価格が急落したことも、株式市場全体の投資家心理を後押しした。

ＡＩ関連株はまちまちで、潤沢な資金を持つＡＩ主力株が上昇した一方、半導体メーカーやデータセンター運営会社は下落した。テキサスやジョージアなど主要なデータセンター立地州で民主党が躍進したことが背景。これらの州では業界の急速な拡大に対する住民の反対が強まっている。

米国株式市場：[.NJP]

＜金先物＞ 米中間選挙で民主党が議会の支配権を獲得したことを受け、ドル安が進行し金相場は３％超上昇した。現物金は１オンス＝４０５９．９５ドルと３．４％高となり、１２月物の米金先物は４０７３ドルで取引を終えた。現物金は１０月３０日に３８６９．８５ドルまで下落して以来、４０００ドル台を回復した。

ＮＹ貴金属：[GOL/XJ]

＜米原油先物＞ ８％超下落し、２カ月超ぶりの安値を付けた。米中間選挙でトランプ米大統領の共和党が上下両院の過半数を失ったことを受け、投資家の間で、勢力図の変化が米国・イスラエルとイランの戦争終結を早めるとの見方が広がった。

清算値は、北海ブレント先物が８．９８ドル（８．７％）安の１バレル＝９４．６２ドル。米ＷＴＩ先物は７．９７ドル（８．３％）安の８８．１２ドルだった。ともに８月３１日以来の安値で引けた。

ＮＹＭＥＸエネルギー：[CR/USJ]

Nov 4 : Goldman Sachs and Apollo Global Management are in talks with investors to sell portions of a roughly $40 billion financing deal for SpaceX's AI chips, Bloomberg News reported on Wednesday. The two firms have begun approaching potential buyers for the multi-tranche financing, with some investors being asked to purchase stakes of up to $500 million ahead of the formal syndication process, the report said, citing people familiar with the matter. The deal, structured to keep debt off SpaceX's balance sheet, is the largest arrangement of its kind for GPUs on record, the report said. Reuters could not independently verify the report.

Goldman Sachs declined Reuters request for comment, while Apollo Global and SpaceX did not immediately respond. SpaceX said in October that an affiliate of Apollo Global Management would buy AI chips and server hardware and lease them to the company in a deal involving about $40 billion in principal payments. The leases will run for a little over five years from the equipment's delivery, which is expected in the first half of 2027. The deal is aimed at financing SpaceX's growing computing needs as it expands its AI business.

FAST

Nov 4 : Kimi Antonelli is basking in the afterglow of becoming Formula One's youngest world champion but his Mercedes team still have a constructors' title to win and they can do it in Sao Paulo this weekend. The 20-year-old Italian and teammate George Russell have put Mercedes 126 points clear of Ferrari with four races to go, meaning Mercedes will be champions for the first time since 2021 if they can stretch their advantage by four points at Interlagos on Sunday. "I'm just trying to gather my energies and focus, trying to give everything for these last races because we have still got to win the constructors' championship, and I want to try to finish very well," Antonelli, who clinched the title in Mexico last Sunday, told Reuters Television. Four points more than Ferrari may sound easily achievable for the winners of 12 of 19 races but Ferrari have outscored Mercedes in the last four outings, despite shooting themselves in the foot in Mexico last weekend.

Seven-time world champion Lewis Hamilton's first pole since 2023 could have been converted into a one-two win had he and teammate Charles Leclerc not clashed on the opening lap and opened the door to Red Bull's Max Verstappen, who won. Leclerc will avoid immediate follow-up questions after he and wife Alexandra announced the birth on Tuesday of daughter Bianca. The Monegasque will miss Thursday's media day with Ferrari junior Dino Beganovic also replacing him in Friday's first practice. VERSTAPPEN HAS THE MOMENTUM Hamilton will be celebrating his 400th start at a circuit where, like Verstappen, he has won three times. Both are on form, with four-time champion Verstappen winning three of the last four races - two from pole position - to catapult himself to second overall. Brazil is the final leg of a triple-header of grands prix on successive weekends and unlike last year, when it was held as a sprint, will have a traditional weekend format. Conditions will still be unpredictable, with rain and sudden thunderstorms always a hazard. "It's going to be a very special weekend. I'm very much looking forward to it because the support from Brazil in general has been incredible, not only this year but already from last year," said Antonelli. The Italian will wear a special helmet in tribute to Brazil's late triple champion Ayrton Senna, an idol who also raced with the number 12 on his car, and to mark the 35th anniversary of his emotional home victory at Interlagos. The home crowd, always supportive of honorary Brazilian Hamilton, are sure to be even more appreciative of Antonelli after he spent time with Senna's family this week. There will be two Brazilians in the race, with Formula Two championship leader Rafael Camara making his F1 debut at Haas after they dropped Esteban Ocon ahead of the Mexico City Grand Prix and Gabriel Bortoleto at Audi. Both Brazilians will be part of a mid-table battle, with seventh-placed Haas only four points clear of Audi. Racing Bulls' Arvid Lindblad will also be wearing a special helmet, his one celebrating the Indian Diwali festival of lights in a nod to his Punjabi heritage. American Colton Herta will again feature for Cadillac in a Friday practice that should finally secure the super licence he needs and could open the door to a race seat next season if the General Motors-backed team decide not to continue with Valtteri Bottas.

Source: Reuters

item.title: 欧州極右系政治指導者、トランプ氏と距離 中間選挙での共和党敗北受け
item.description:
Crispian Balmer Ludwig Burger David Latona Luiza Ilie
[ロンドン ４日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Crispian Balmer　Ludwig Burger　David Latona　Luiza Ilie

[ロンドン ４日 ロイター] - 米中間選挙でトランプ大統領が属する与党・共和党が大敗したことを受け、欧州の極右系政治指導者らの間でトランプ氏と距離を置く姿勢が出始めている。ただ、多くはトランプ氏本人への直接的な批判は避けている。

欧州の極右系政治指導者の多くは、トランプ氏の２０２４年大統領選での勝利を受け思想的な近さを公然と称賛。一部は首都ワシントンを訪問したほか、トランプ氏の盟友の実業家イーロン・マスク氏の支援も受けるなどしていたため、トランプ氏に対する姿勢の変化は注目される。

こうした変化を象徴する１人が、世論調査で次期政権を担う可能性もあると見られているフランス極右政党「国民連合（ＲＮ）」のバルデラ党首。バルデラ氏は、トランプ氏の２期目政権は２０１７─２１年の１期目ほど孤立主義的ではないとし、「イランを巡る米国の介入は世界経済に極めて大きな影響を及ぼしている」と述べた。ただ、その介入の責任がトランプ氏にあるとは明言しなかった。

ドイツでは、極右政党「ドイツのための選択肢（ＡｆＤ）」のワイデル共同党首が、中間選挙での共和党敗北の原因はイラン問題にあったと示唆。ニュースサイトＴオンラインに対し「トランプ氏は有権者に対し、介入主義的な外交政策を追求しないと確約していた。この確約違反が今になって共和党に跳ね返ってきた」と述べた。

イタリアでは、連立与党の一角を占める極右政党「同盟」のサルビーニ党首が「米中間選挙の結果は、特に戦争や国際的な緊張の高まり、生活費の上昇の影響を受けた。こうした負担は各家庭に直接のしかかっている」と指摘。「今回の選挙結果が紛争終結と平和回復に向けた動きの加速につながることを期待する」と語った。

イタリアの元陸軍大将で極右政党「フトゥーロ・ナツィオナーレ（国家の未来）」を率いるロベルト・バンナッチ氏は、今回の選挙結果で公約を実現できなかった場合の政治的リスクが示されたと指摘。通信社ＡＮＳＡに対し「トランプ氏は期待に応えることができなかった。ロシアとウクライナの戦争を終わらせることもできなかった上、イランとの戦争を始めた」と述べ、こうしたことに伴うエネルギー価格の上昇や経済・株式市場の混乱で米国の中間所得層が打撃を受けたことが中間選挙の結果につながったとの認識を示した。

バンナッチ氏は当初はトランプ氏の「米国第一主義」に基づくナショナリズム政治を称賛していたが、その後は外交政策を巡りトランプ氏を批判していた。

一方、ルーマニアの野党・強硬右派政党「ルーマニア人統一同盟（ＡＵＲ）」のドゥンガチウ副党首は、トランプ氏の「政治的な死」を伝える報道は「大いに誇張されている」と指摘。「トランプ氏が自動的に無力な大統領になるわけではない。むしろ共和党が議会多数派を握る体制から、行政府と議会がより強く相互に牽制し合う体制へ移行するだけだ」と述べた。

政治リスク分析会社ユーラシア・グループのマネジングディレクター、ムジタバ・ラーマン氏は、欧州の極右政党指導者らは政治的な利益を意識してトランプ氏と距離を置こうとしていると指摘。ロイターに対し「特に生活費の高騰を巡ってトランプ氏に対する不満が高まる中、かつては政治的な資産だったものが選挙上の重荷に変わるリスクがある」と述べた。

その上で、欧州の極右指導者らは「トランプ主義がもたらす思想的な追い風」は享受したい一方で、「トランプ政権に伴う混乱や経済的な混乱」の責任は負いたくないという、都合の良い立場を取ろうとしているように見えると指摘。「欧州の極右勢力を欧州既成政治との戦いにおける思想的な同志とみなしているトランプ氏や『ＭＡＧＡ（米国を再び偉大に）』陣営が、政治的支援を引き揚げたり、さらには敵対したりする可能性もある」と警告した。

item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米国株式市場＝ダウ1500ドル超高、民主圧勝受け　データセンターは安い 6:31 配信

米ニューヨーク証券取引所（NYSE）で11月4日撮影。REUTERS/Jeenah Moon（ロイター） ［４日　ロイター］ - 米国株式市場は大幅高で取引を終えた。中間選挙で民主党が圧勝し、政治的不透明感が後退したことでリスク選好が強まった。一方、人工知能（ＡＩ）規制が強化されるとの懸念から、データセンター関連株は下落した。

民主党は上下両院で過半数を奪還した。共和党の牙城にも食い込んで幅広い勝利を収め、有権者がトランプ大統領に厳しい審判を下した形となった。

一部の大型ハイテク株は、ＡＩインフラの拡大鈍化が競争上有利になるとの見方から上昇した。一方、ＡＩインフラ整備の一端を担う比較的小規模な企業は、拡大鈍化が財務を圧迫するとの懸念から下落した。議会の勢力図の変化によってイラン戦争の終結が早まるとの観測から原油価格が急落したことも、株式市場全体の投資家心理を後押しした。

ＵＳバンク・ウェルス・マネジメントのチーフエクイティストラテジスト、テリー・サンドベン氏は「選挙結果が明確になり、不確実性が低下したことで株価は大幅に上昇している」と指摘。「選挙によって政策運営にある程度のこう着状態が生じる。こうした状況は株価にとって好ましいことが多く、きょうもその効果が一部表れている」と述べた。

ＡＩ関連株はまちまちで、潤沢な資金を持つＡＩ主力株が上昇した一方、半導体メーカーやデータセンター運営会社は下落した。テキサスやジョージアなど主要なデータセンター立地州で民主党が躍進したことが背景。これらの州では業界の急速な拡大に対する住民の反対が強まっている。

こうした値動きは、ＡＩインフラ拡大の鈍化によってハイテク企業の資金負担が和らぐ可能性がある一方、急速な建設拡大に成長を依存する運営会社や供給業者には圧力がかかるとの見方を反映している。

ＡＩ主力株ではマイクロソフトが６．７％、アマゾン・ドット・コムが６．１％、アルファベットが３．２％、メタ・プラットフォームズが１．４％、それぞれ上昇。一方、データセンター運営のハット８は２３％、ＩＲＥＮは１１％、コア・サイエンティフィックは１０％、アプライド・デジタルは６．７％の大幅安となった。

フィラデルフィア半導体指数は３．１％下落し、６カ月ぶりの安値を付けた。

ＡＭＤは１％高。データセンター向け販売が急増し、２０２７年の売上高見通しが市場予想を上回った。

イーロン・マスク氏率いるスペースＸとテスラはともに３％超下落。同氏は共和党候補の支援に５億ドル近くを投じ、両社が本拠を置くテキサス州での共和党の支配維持などに向けて資金を提供していた。

防衛関連のノースロップ・グラマン、ＲＴＸ、ロッキード・マーチンは下落した。トランプ氏が求める１兆５０００億ドルの国防予算が、議会での承認に向けて一段と厳しい状況に直面する可能性がある。

太陽光発電やクリーンエネルギー関連株は上昇。民主党の圧勝により、クリーンエネルギー開発に対する連邦政府の支援が維持されるとの見方が広がった。

item.title: 米クアルコム、10─12月売上高見通し予想超え 非スマホ分野堅調
item.description: [４日 ロイター] - 米半導体大手クアルコムは４日、第１・四半期（１０─１２月期）の売上高が市場予想を上回るとの見...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米クアルコム、10─12月売上高見通し予想超え　非スマホ分野堅調 6:28 配信

米クアルコムのロゴとコンピュータのマザーボード。2025年8月25日撮影。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic（ロイター） [４日 ロイター] - 米半導体大手クアルコムは４日、第１・四半期（１０─１２月期）の売上高が市場予想を上回るとの見通しを示した。自動車やＩｏＴ（モノのインターネット）といった分野の成長が、主力のスマートフォン向け半導体事業の需要低迷による打撃を和らげていることを示唆した。

クアルコムの第１・四半期の売上高見通しは１０４億─１１２億ドルと、中間値はＬＳＥＧがまとめたアナリストの平均予想（１０４億８０００万ドル）を上回った。

半導体部門の売上高は９０億─９６億ドルとの見通しを示し、市場予想の８８億８０００万ドルを上回った。

調整後１株当たり利益見通しは２．１５─２．３５ドル。市場予想は２．２７ドルだった。

併せて発表した第４・四半期の調整後売上高は７％減の１０４億４０００万ドルと、市場予想の１０１億１０００万ドルを上回った。

調整後１株当たり利益は２．１７ドル。市場予想は２．１６ドルだった。

第４・四半期の携帯端末部門の売上高は２６％減の５１億４０００万ドルで、半導体部門の売上高を８％減の９０億２０００万ドルへと押し下げた。ビジブル・アルファがまとめたアナリスト予想は５２億５０００万ドルだった。

Nov 4 : Fintech firm Chime raised its forecast for full-year revenue growth above Wall Street estimates on Wednesday, betting on sustained demand for its digital banking products. Here are more details: • Consumer spending remained resilient, supporting growth in the sector as households and businesses continued to spend despite higher oil prices and inflationary pressures stemming from the US war with Iran. • "While consumers are expressing concern about affordability, the reality is they're actually remaining very resilient and confident in how they spend," Mark Troughton, interim CFO, told Reuters, adding that the company was seeing "a very strong and resilient consumer."

FAST

Nov 4 : Arm Holdings beat Wall Street estimates for second-quarter revenue on Wednesday, driven by higher royalty payments and licensing fees from customers deploying its chip architecture in AI-related computing products. Unlike chipmakers that manufacture semiconductors, Arm Holdings licenses its processor architecture and earns royalties on chips shipped using its technology, making licensing fees and royalty payments the company's primary sources of revenue. Arm said its server-chip architecture accounted for more than 50 per cent of deployments at major cloud providers in 2025 and is expected to exceed 60 per cent by the end of 2026. Shares of the company fell about 2 per cent in extended trading.

Demand for Arm-based technology has benefited from the AI boom, as major cloud companies develop custom processors for data-center workloads. Arm's architecture is prized for its power efficiency, an increasingly important factor as operators seek to rein in the energy and cooling costs of running large AI models. Revenue from royalties, which Arm collects on each chip shipped using its technology, rose 8 per cent to $670 million for the second quarter, compared with estimates of $720.8 million. Licensing revenue, which includes upfront fees for access to its technology, was $773 million, compared with estimates of $625.1 million. The company's second-quarter revenue of $1.44 billion beat analysts' average estimate of $1.38 billion, according to data compiled by LSEG. Arm's adjusted profit of 52 cents per share surpassed estimates of 47 cents per share. The company projected third-quarter revenue of $1.54 billion, compared with the average analyst estimate of $1.53 billion. Last month, a Delaware jury found Arm breached parts of its licensing agreement with Qualcomm and interfered with the latter's relationship with Meta, but awarded only $2 in damages, leaving key disputes over royalties and future licensing terms to be decided by a judge.

Source: Reuters

item.description: Nov 4 : Qualcomm on Wednesday fell short of Wall Street estimates for fourth-quarter revenue from its smartphone chips on sluggish demand and declining Apple-related revenue, sending its shares down more than 6 per cent in extended trading.Demand for lucrative high-bandwidth storage for AI servers has pushed

FAST

Nov 4 : Qualcomm on Wednesday fell short of Wall Street estimates for fourth-quarter revenue from its smartphone chips on sluggish demand and declining Apple-related revenue, sending its shares down more than 6 per cent in extended trading. Demand for lucrative high-bandwidth storage for AI servers has pushed up memory chip prices, raising the cost of consumer electronics and squeezing smartphone processor designers such as Qualcomm. Global smartphone shipments fell 20 per cent in the September quarter to a 14-year low, according to Counterpoint Research. Revenue from Qualcomm's handset unit, which makes chips for smartphones, fell 26 per cent to $5.14 billion in the fourth quarter, dragging the chip segment's revenue down 8 per cent to $9.02 billion. Analysts polled by Visible Alpha expected handset revenue of $5.25 billion.

In an interview with Reuters, Qualcomm CEO Cristiano Amon said sales of Android handsets had bottomed out and were ticking upward again. "Unlike some other companies, we called this memory thing early, and we said we prepared for it," Amon said. "We're starting to see sequential growth now on Android. We have been really executing on the non-handset business." Investors had also worried over Apple switching to using its own modem chips and Qualcomm's warning of a faster-than-expected decline in sales to the iPhone maker. Amon said the first-quarter fiscal 2027 forecast given on Wednesday includes no further sales from Apple, while Qualcomm has been winning deals with other customers beyond the smartphone business. "We have within the year a 70 per cent increase year-over-year in the design wins in fiscal 2027, with Apple out of the model," Amon said. "We expect the non-handset (revenue) to replace Apple entirely, and you're going to see 60 per cent year-over-year growth in the non-handset business as you go to fiscal '27." The smartphone chipmaker expects first-quarter revenue to be between $10.4 billion and $11.2 billion, the midpoint of which is above analysts' average estimate of $10.48 billion, according to data compiled by LSEG. It expects sales in its chip segment to be between $9 billion and $9.6 billion, exceeding estimates of $8.88 billion. Adjusted profit is expected to be between $2.15 and $2.35 per share, compared with estimates of $2.27. A September agreement allowing Amazon to buy up to $60 billion of Qualcomm's AI chips and related data-center products added the e-commerce giant to a client roster that includes Microsoft and Meta Platforms. Qualcomm valued the warrants to Amazon, which are similar to those issued by rivals such as AMD to customers, at about $1.8 billion when the deal was signed, with the online giant able to acquire up to 25 million shares as purchase commitments and spending milestones are met. Qualcomm has said revenue from two custom chip programs with hyperscalers would begin in the current quarter ahead of a ramp-up of its AI accelerator products next year as it targets $15 billion in annual data-center revenue by fiscal 2029. Earlier on Wednesday, the company signed a multi-year 5G deal to supply radio equipment, baseband units and software for SpaceX's planned nationwide Starlink Mobile network starting in 2027. Adjusted sales in the fourth quarter fell 7 per cent to $10.44 billion, beating estimates of $10.11 billion. Adjusted profit came in at $2.17 per share, compared with estimates of $2.16.

Source: Reuters

item.title: 原油先物8％超下落、米共和党敗北でイラン戦争終結に期待
item.description:
Arathy Somasekhar
[ヒューストン ４日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Arathy Somasekhar

[ヒューストン ４日 ロイター] - 米国時間の原油先物は８％超下落し、２カ月超ぶりの安値を付けた。米中間選挙でトランプ米大統領の共和党が上下両院の過半数を失ったことを受け、投資家の間で、勢力図の変化が米国・イスラエルとイランの戦争終結を早めるとの見方が広がった。

清算値は、北海ブレント先物が８．９８ドル（８．７％）安の１バレル＝９４．６２ドル。米ＷＴＩ先物は７．９７ドル（８．３％）安の８８．１２ドルだった。ともに８月３１日以来の安値で引けた。

バンス米副大統領は４日、Ｘへの投稿で、トランプ大統領が進めた対イラン戦争との距離を置く姿勢を示し、その意義に疑問を呈するとともに、中間選挙で野党・民主党に議会支配を許した有権者の厳しい審判は全面的にイラン戦争に原因があったとの認識を示した。

一方、トランプ米大統領は、対イラン戦争が共和党敗北の一因になったと認めながらも、戦争には価値があったとの考えを示した。

トランプ氏は今、交渉による戦争終結か、リスクの高い戦闘激化かの選択を迫られている。湾岸諸国の政府関係者に近い関係筋２人によると、政治基盤が弱まったトランプ氏は、軍事的な選択肢を制約し得る民主党主導の議会に直面し、合意を目指す動機が強まっている。イランへの全面攻撃の可能性は低下したという。

ただ、湾岸地域のアナリストらは、イランが明確な勝利を宣言でき、トランプ氏が敗北したと映るような合意は、自制を促すのと同じくらい、無謀な行動を誘発しかねないと指摘した。

FAST

Nov 4 : BC Partners, which provides financing to middle-market companies, is dropping its bid to relaunch LIV Golf due to an inability to secure enough player commitments, the Financial Times reported on Wednesday. The professional men's golf league, a competitor to the PGA Tour, filed for bankruptcy protection in New Jersey in September as part of a restructuring after Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund, which has invested more than $5 billion in LIV since its launch in 2022, announced it was ending its financial backing after the 2026 season.  LIV has said it plans to continue operating while it reorganizes. The private capital firm's decision came as a deadline loomed to show there was enough player support to hold a tournament series in 2027, the FT said, citing people directly familiar with the matter.

BC Partners and LIV Golf did not immediately respond to Reuters requests for comment.  Former world number one Jon Rahm is among a wave of high-profile golfers who have left LIV Golf since it filed for bankruptcy protection. LIV is expected to appear at a Thursday hearing in US bankruptcy court in Trenton, New Jersey, to discuss various contracts, leases and assets. It is unclear whether LIV's ultimate fate may also be discussed. In October, BC Partners made an initial investment in LIV Golf and planned to provide up to $300 million in financing to help the league emerge from restructuring and strengthen its finances ahead of the 2027 season. LIV Golf launched in 2022 with funding from Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund and lured leading players from the PGA Tour including Phil Mickelson, Bryson DeChambeau, Brooks Koepka and Dustin Johnson with lucrative contracts. DeChambeau, one of the biggest names on LIV's player roster, said recently the business model for the league's proposed 2.0 era "makes a lot of sense" and that he hoped that it would last "forever". Others have been critical of LIV Golf, with DP World Tour chief executive Guy Kinnings saying that LIV had sought to undermine the European circuit.  "They took players; they took sponsors; they turned professional golf into an arms race," Rory McIlroy told reporters earlier on Wednesday ahead of the Abu Dhabi Championship.

Source: Reuters

item.title: 米中間選挙で躍進の民主党、トランプ政権監視強化へ 政治膠着の可能性
item.description:
Gram Slattery David Morgan Jason Lange
[ワシントン ４日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Gram Slattery　David Morgan　Jason Lange

[ワシントン　４日　ロイター] - 米中間選挙で躍進した野党・民主党は４日、共和党のトランプ大統領に対する監視を強化する方針を示し、米国は向こう２年にわたり政治的な膠着状態に陥る可能性が高まった。

３日投開票の中間選挙では民主党が連邦議会上下両院の過半数を奪還。共和党の牙城にも食い込んで幅広い勝利を収め、有権者がトランプ大統領に厳しい審判を下した形となった。共和党のトランプ氏は２０１７─２０２１年にも大統領を務めたが、民主党が支配する議会と向き合うのは今回が初めてとなる。

下院民主党トップのジェフリーズ院内総務は、民主党は生活費負担の軽減と政権の説明責任の追及に重点を置くと表明。「われわれはドナルド・トランプ氏のために働いているのではない。米国民のために働いている」とし、「下院がトランプ政権の完全な下請け機関のように機能した時代は終わった」と語った。

民主党の下院過半数奪還を受け、ジェフリーズ氏は下院議長に就任する見通し。関係筋によると、共和党のジョンソン下院議長は下院共和党トップの少数党院内総務選に立候補しない意向を固めた。

こうした中、トランプ大統領はこの日、記者団をホワイトハウスに招き、自ら建設を進めるホワイトハウスのボールルーム（宴会場）を披露。トランプ氏は「『なぜホワイトハウスの工事などしているのか』と批判されることがあるが、ホワイトハウスは米国を象徴する究極の存在で、完璧な状態でなければならない」とし、「私にとっては気分転換になる」と語った。

記者団と約１時間に及んだやり取りの中で中間選挙の結果に触れたのはわずかで、「民主党が破壊的な行動に出ない限り、おそらくうまくやっていけるだろう」と述べるにとどめた。ただ「私には拒否権がある」と改めて強調した。

トランプ氏は憲法の規定により３選を目指すことはできないが、対イラン戦争が共和党の中間選挙敗北の一因になったことを認める一方で、自らの判断は正しかったとの立場を崩さなかった。一方、２８年大統領選でトランプ氏の後継候補になる可能性があるバンス副大統領は、２月に開始した対イラン攻撃が中間選挙での敗北の一因になったとの考えを示し、トランプ氏と一線を画した。

バンス氏はＸへ長文の投稿で「われわれが（中間選挙で）敗北した理由は戦争だ」とし、「それでも、戦争には価値があった、今後６年間にわたり上院（の多数派）を失う代償を払うだけの価値があったと主張したいなら、そうすればいい」と指摘。過去に自身が戦争終結を勧告したことについても「妥当な助言だった」とした。

トランプ氏は、対イラン戦争が共和党の中間選挙での敗北の一因になったと認めながらも、戦争には価値があったとの考えを表明。記者団に対し「イランの件はやらなければならなかったし、今後も続けていく」と述べ、イランが核兵器を保有するのを阻止するために戦争は価値があったと主張した。

バンス氏の投稿は問題視しない考えを示し、「その戦争について言えば、私なら違う対応はしなかった」と述べ、自分自身が中間選挙の投票対象だったら勝利していたと改めて主張。「選挙集会では信じられないほどの熱狂と支持があったが、その支持を候補者たちに移し替えることはできなかった」と語った。

item.title: 欧州市場サマリー（4日）
item.description: ＜ロンドン株式市場＞ 反発して取引を終えた。３日に投開票された米中間選挙で民主党が圧勝したことを受けたドル安に伴い...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
欧州市場サマリー（4日） 5:37 配信

＜ロンドン株式市場＞　反発して取引を終えた。３日に投開票された米中間選挙で民主党が圧勝したことを受けたドル安に伴い金価格が上昇し、貴金属株などが買われた。中型株で構成するＦＴＳＥ２５０種指数は０．９８％上昇した。

イングランド銀行（英中央銀行）が５日に開く金融政策決定会合で２５ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）の利上げを決定するとの見方が市場では強い。

ＦＴＳＥ３５０種銀行株指数は４．４８％高。銀行大手バークレイズ、スタンダード・チャータード、ロイズ、ＨＳＢＣ、ナットウエストは３．６─５．３％上昇した。業績見通しを維持したメトロ・バンクは１７．４％値上がりした。

貴金属株指数は６．５１％高。

生活必需品株指数は２．６６％上昇。小売り大手マークス・アンド・スペンサー（Ｍ＆Ｓ）は決算発表を受け、６．４％高だった。

一方、原油先物価格の下落を受け、石油・ガス株指数は２．１５％値下がりした。

ロンドン株式市場：[.LJP]

＜欧州株式市場＞　反発して取引を終えた。３日に投開票された米中間選挙で民主党が圧勝したことを受け、買い注文が優勢だった。銀行株の比重が大きいスペインのＩＢＥＸ指数は３．００％上昇した。

ＳＴＯＸＸユーロ圏銀行株指数は４．６２％高。

トランプ米政権下で事業に逆風を受けていたデンマークの風力発電機大手ベスタスは２．９％、オーステッドは４．６％、ドイツの風力タービンメーカー、ノルデックスは４．８％いずれも上昇した。

通期業績見通しを上方修正したデンマークの製薬大手ノボノルディスクは５．６％値上がりした。

ＳＴＯＸＸ欧州６００種テクノロジー株指数は０．２０％安。ドイツの半導体大手インフィニオン・テクノロジーズは４．１％、フランスの半導体材料大手ソイテックは１１．８％、配電・制御機器大手シュナイダー・エレクトリックは３．４％、ドイツのシーメンス・エナジーは８．０％いずれも下落した。米国で人工知能（ＡＩ）関連の規制が強化されるとの懸念から、売られた。

原油先物価格の下落を受け、石油・ガス株指数は２．３５％下落した。

１０月のユーロ圏消費者物価指数（ＨＩＣＰ）速報値は前年同月比４．０％上昇。欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）が１２月の会合で利上げを決定するとの観測が強まるとみられる。

欧州株式市場：[.FJ]

＜ユーロ圏債券＞　ドイツ国債に対するフランスおよびイタリアの国債利回り格差が縮小した。米議会を民主党が制したことで地政学的な緊張が和らぎ、リスク選好を支えるとの観測が広がった。

３日投開票の米中間選挙では、民主党が上下両院の過半数を奪還した。共和党の牙城にも食い込んで幅広い勝利を収め、有権者がトランプ大統領に厳しい審判を下した形となった。

ドイツ１０年債利回りは約２ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）低下の３．２９％。米１０年債利回りが３ｂｐ低下の４．９２％となる動きに追随した。

エネルギー価格の急落により、中央銀行がさらなる利上げを迫られる圧力が和らぐとの期待が高まり、フランスやイタリアなど債務残高の大きい国にとって安心材料となった。

フランス国債利回りは１１ｂｐ低下の４．８２％。独仏１０年債利回り格差は１０ｂｐ縮小の１５１．８ｂｐとなった。同利回り格差は１０月下旬に１７７．７ｂｐまで拡大し、２０１１年のユーロ圏債務危機以来の高水準に達していた。

イタリア国債利回りは９ｂｐ低下の４．３６％。独伊１０年債利回り格差は６．５０ｂｐ縮小の１０５．８０ｂｐと、１０月２１日以来の低水準となった。

アリアンツ・グローバル・インベスターズの債券スペシャリスト、マッシミリアーノ・マクシア氏は「民主党の勝利がより安定した世界環境を支える可能性があるとの見方から、金融市場全体でリスク選好が高まっている」と指摘。「これまで激しい売り圧力にさらされてきた債券も回復しており、イタリアとフランスの国債が主な恩恵を受けている」と語った。

ユーロ圏金融・債券市場：[DE/BJ]

item.title: ＮＹ外為市場＝ドル下落、米中間選挙で民主党圧勝 不透明感後退
item.description: ［ニューヨーク ４日 ロイター］ - 終盤のニューヨーク外為市場では、ドルが序盤の安値からは持ち直したものの、下落して取...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＮＹ外為市場＝ドル下落、米中間選挙で民主党圧勝　不透明感後退 5:31 配信

3月24日撮影の米ドル紙幣。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic（ロイター） ［ニューヨーク　４日　ロイター］ - 終盤のニューヨーク外為市場では、ドルが序盤の安値からは持ち直したものの、下落して取引を終えた。米中間選挙で民主党が圧勝し、市場の不透明感が後退した。

３日投開票の米中間選挙で、民主党が上下両院の過半数を奪還した。不人気な対イラン戦争への強い不満や生活費高騰への不安、トランプ氏の政権運営に対する怒りを背景に、有権者がトランプ大統領に厳しい審判を下した形となった。

今回の結果を受け、市場にとって不透明要因が一つ取り除かれた。市場はイラン戦争の影響や、成長とインフレを押し上げている人工知能（ＡＩ）ブームへの対応に苦慮している。投資家がイラン戦争を巡る米政府の次の一手を見極めようとする中、この日の原油価格は急落した。

シルバー・ゴールド・ブルの外為・貴金属リスク管理ディレクター、エリック・ブレガー氏は「リスクオンの雰囲気だ。恐らく『うわさで売って事実で買う』動きと、不正選挙の結果を巡る泥沼にはまらずに済んだという安心感が交錯しているのだろう」と指摘。「ファンダメンタルズ面では、データセンターなどに関する民主党の立場を踏まえると、ＡＩを巡る懸念が一段と強まる可能性は依然として残る。だが当面は、トランプ氏がこの結果に抵抗しないという安心感が市場に広がっている。全般的にリスクオンとなれば、ドルにとっては概ねマイナス要因となる」と述べた。

主要通貨に対するドル指数は０．２５％安の１０１．６０。取引序盤で、９月３０日以来の安値となる１０１．２１まで下げる場面もあった。

ドルは対円で０．１４％安の１５８．４３円。

ユーロは０．２１％高の１．１２１７ドル。

英ポンドは０．３８％高の１．３４６２ドル。一時、７週間ぶりの高値となる１．３５０３ドルまで上昇した。英ポンドは６営業日続伸の勢いで、これは７月６日まで続いた８営業日続伸以来の長さとなる。イングランド銀行（英中央銀行）は５日に金融政策を発表する。

ＣＭＥのフェドウオッチによると、市場が織り込む米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が１２月の会合で少なくとも２５ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）利上げする確率は８１．２％と、前日の７７．４％から上昇した。

ドル／円　ＮＹ終値 158.42/158.47

始値 158.42

高値 158.66

安値 158.18

ユーロ／ドル　ＮＹ終値 1.1227/1.1230

始値 1.1254

Nov 4 : Apple has reduced employee budgets for AI usage as part of a broader effort to rein in costs, even as it seeks to expand the use of AI across its operations, Bloomberg News reported on Wednesday, citing people familiar with the matter. Here are the details: • Apple last month cut the daily AI spending allowance for some engineers to $200 from $300, the report said • The company is considering further reductions for some engineering teams, potentially lowering daily limits to $100

LONDON, Nov 4 : Australia have thoroughly reviewed last month’s mauling by the All Blacks in the two Bledisloe Cup encounters and feel they have fixed many of the failings as they head into a month of Nations Championship tests in Britain. Loosehead prop Angus Bell said they had looked to address the weaknesses exposed by New Zealand in their 50-19 win in Auckland and then a runaway 43-21 triumph in Sydney a week later. “Look, rugby is not really a linear line. There's a lot of ups and downs. Both in people's careers and with teams,” Bell told a press conference on Wednesday as they began preparations for Sunday’s clash against England at Twickenham. “As we know, it's always like a bit of a roller coaster, but as long as you're trending upwards, I think that's the main point of getting better collectively as a team and also individually.”

Bell said the All Blacks had put Australia under pressure with the pace of their game. “They were excellent at that, and that's where we struggled, and that's something that we've implemented in our training to get better.  “We didn't learn the lessons from the first test match, and then they exposed us on the other ones in the second and I feel like the training week we had prior to coming over here and also now today has been really good, and we've actually addressed those and fixed those.” The 26-year-old Bell said there had been many positives for the Wallabies in recent months under new coach Les Kiss as they put together an unbeaten run of six matches before the blowout against New Zealand. “I guess my point is we've got to be able to change and manoeuvre between teams. Like England aren't going to be the same as the All Blacks. Do they suit us more or not?  “It's all about how we prepare, how we train, how we play. We did cop a lot of criticism (after defeat by the All Blacks), but again, that's part of rugby and we know that it is.” Australia will also play against Scotland and Wales before the Nations Championship finals weekend at Twickenham on November 27-29.

Nov 4 : Romanian gymnast Ana Maria Barbosu has been banned for two years after committing three whereabouts failures under anti-doping rules, the Court of Arbitration for Sport's Anti-Doping Division said on Wednesday. The 20-year-old's ban runs from May 5, 2026, when her provisional suspension began, leaving her eligible to return in May 2028, about two months before the Los Angeles Olympics, subject to any appeal. Barbosu contested the proposed consequences and requested a hearing before CAS ADD, but a judge ruled that her three whereabouts failures between September and December 2025 had been “correctly recorded”. Athletes in registered testing pools must provide their whereabouts, including a daily 60-minute time slot during which they can be located for out-of-competition testing.

Any combination of three missed tests and/or filing failures within a 12-month period constitutes an anti-doping rule violation, for which the standard sanction is two years, subject to the athlete's degree of fault. "The Court of Arbitration for Sport Anti-Doping Division (CAS ADD) has partially upheld a request for disciplinary proceedings by World Gymnastics against gymnast Ana Maria Barbosu," CAS ADD said in a statement. CAS ADD said the request was only partially upheld because Barbosu's competitive results since December 2025 would not be disqualified. The International Testing Agency (ITA), which administers World Gymnastics' anti-doping programme, said it acknowledged the ruling. The floor exercise bronze medal Barbosu won at the 2024 Paris Olympics remains the subject of a separate CAS case involving American gymnast Jordan Chiles after the Swiss Federal Tribunal referred the dispute back to CAS for reconsideration. CAS said on Wednesday that the parties in that case had requested that no hearing be held before May 2027 while written proceedings continue.

item.description: The US president repeatedly branded him a jihadist. His Republican opponent questioned his loyalty to America. Campaign mailers suggested he had ...

World

Politics of fear failed to stop El-Sayed’s historic US Senate win

Reuters

05 November, 2026 01:30 am IST

Follow Us:

-->

Facebook

X

LinkedIn

WhatsApp

Email

Copy Link

(c) Copyright Thomson Reuters 2026

Stay updated with ThePrint:

Preferred Source

Google Discover

-->

By Nathan Layne DEARBORN, Michigan, Nov 4 (Reuters) – The US president repeatedly branded him a jihadist. His Republican opponent questioned his loyalty to America. Campaign mailers suggested he had ties to terrorists and warned that, if elected, he would bring sharia law to Michigan.

Before Abdul El-Sayed could make history as the first Muslim elected to the US Senate, he endured what critics called one of the most overtly Islamophobic campaigns in modern US politics.

He won anyway. El-Sayed cast his victory in Tuesday’s midterm elections as a rebuke to such rhetoric, accusing his Republican opponent Mike Rogers of running what he called a historically ugly, hate-based campaign.

Show Full Article

“You chose hate, and Michigan chose hope,” El-Sayed said in his victory speech.

The attacks were a defining feature of the race, stirring safety concerns among residents in and around Dearborn, home to one of the nation’s largest Arab American communities, local officials and residents said this week.

El-Sayed, 42, a Michigan-born Egyptian American who has a medical degree and formerly served as Detroit’s health director, ran as a progressive focused on healthcare and the cost of living.

David Kolar, a 32-year-old music teacher, said the focus on El-Sayed’s faith recalled the backlash Muslims faced after the September 11, 2001, attacks, a period he believed the country had left behind.

“We have freedom of religion, and if he is of the Muslim faith, so be it,” Kolar said after casting his ballot for El-Sayed in the Detroit suburb of Warren.

Rogers said his objections to El-Sayed were ideological, not religious. Yet he portrayed him as a national security threat and campaigned alongside Republicans who went further.

Foremost among them was President Donald Trump, who labeled El-Sayed a terrorist and compared him to the September 11 hijackers. Rogers appeared with Senator John Kennedy, a Louisiana Republican who said El-Sayed sleeps “in a bin Laden jersey,” and with Senator Ted Cruz, a Texas Republican, when he called El-Sayed a “jihadist leprechaun” and warned Americans would die if he won.

The attacks stood out not only for their severity but for how readily prominent Republicans embraced them, said Nazita Lajevardi, an associate professor at the University of Michigan who studies the intersection of politics, race and religion.

Unlike after September 11 or during Trump’s first-term Muslim ban, she said, there was little pushback from Republican party elites.

“This is the most egregious and most bigoted Islamophobic campaign I have seen,” she said. “What you’re seeing is not just hostility, racism and bigotry from the president … but you’re seeing it from rank-and-file members of the Republican Party.”

ANATOMY OF AN ATTACK CAMPAIGN

Led by Trump, Republicans portrayed Democratic candidates as radical, un-American and even communist throughout the campaign. Democratic Senate candidate James Talarico was derided in Texas as “Talafreako” over his views on gender and sexuality. In Ohio, ads weaponized Democratic gubernatorial candidate Amy Acton’s account of surviving sexual assault in her youth.

Voters appeared far more concerned with pocketbook issues than attacks, however, in an election season when Democrats, including Talarico and Acton, chalked up sweeping wins.

Still, perhaps no campaign leaned into identity politics as heavily as the Michigan Senate race.

Republicans sought to link El-Sayed to the Muslim Brotherhood using decade-old writings on political change in Egypt and social media posts by his half-sister. The United States designated some Brotherhood branches as terrorist organizations this year. El-Sayed disavowed the group and denied any association, and no evidence has emerged linking him to it.

Republicans also seized on El-Sayed’s response to the March attack on Michigan’s Temple Israel synagogue. In a statement denouncing the violence, he said “hurt people hurt people,” drawing anger from some Jewish leaders who criticized the remark as rationalizing antisemitic violence.

He later apologized, saying that his comments may have been misconstrued and that “it wasn’t the time for context.”

Rogers’ allies invoked the episode through the campaign’s final hours. On the eve of the election, the Michigan Republican Party held a press conference featuring Jewish and Black community leaders opposed to El-Sayed beside a large red sign accusing him of offering “SAFE HARBOR TO TERRORISTS.”

Asked by Reuters to substantiate the claim, party communications director Ted Goodman pointed to the “hurt people hurt people” remark, which he said amounted to justifying a terrorist attack against children.

The argument resonated with some voters. Five of roughly 30 people Reuters interviewed in the Detroit area said El-Sayed’s Muslim faith or perceived links to extremism strongly influenced their vote for Rogers.

Robin Cook, 73, was one of them. “I don’t think he’s a true American,” he said of El-Sayed. “I don’t trust him.”

DEARBORN PUSHES BACK

Most voters interviewed dismissed the attacks as desperate and a distraction from their economic concerns. Non-Muslims stressed that Muslims and Arab Americans were woven into their daily lives, pointing to friends, neighbors, colleagues and physicians in their communities.

“I grew up around all nationalities,” said Pamela Johnson, a 72-year-old Catholic, after voting for El-Sayed. “We all matter, regardless of color, race or whatever.”

But Dearborn residents said the rhetoric carried real-world consequences, fueling safety fears.

Imad Soofi, a business owner who immigrated from Yemen two decades ago, said he had seen a rise in anti-Muslim hostility since Trump began targeting El-Sayed, including remarks directed at women wearing hijabs in public.

A three-time Trump voter, Soofi, 49, said he might have backed Rogers had the candidate distanced himself from Trump’s anti-Muslim rhetoric. Instead, he voted for El-Sayed.

Alabas Farhat, who represents parts of Dearborn and Detroit in the Michigan House, said the campaign recycled anti-Muslim tropes Arab Americans in the region had encountered for years.

“There has been this constant questioning of how American can you be as a Muslim? How American can you be as an Arab American?” Farhat said in an interview. “It happens, but time and again, we show how American we are.”

(Reporting by Nathan Layne in Dearborn, Detroit, Warren, and Harrison Township, Michigan; editing by Paul Thomasch and Howard Goller)

FAST

Nov 4 : Federico Valverde struck in stoppage time to give Real Madrid a dramatic 3-2 Champions League victory at AEK Athens on Wednesday, while Liverpool surrendered the lead twice in a 3-2 defeat at Fenerbahce. Real twice came from behind to maintain their perfect start and sit second on 12 points from four matches, behind Paris St Germain on goal difference. AEK threatened from the outset and their early pressure was rewarded in the 12th minute when Aboubakary Koita cut inside and fired into the top corner from just inside the box. Thibaut Courtois denied Luka Jovic before Jude Bellingham, who had an effort ruled out for offside in the 27th minute, equalised five minutes later with a deft backheel from Marc Cucurella's low cross.

Koita's driving run and pass set up Stavros Pilios to restore AEK's lead in the 75th minute, his low shot going through Courtois' legs. Kylian Mbappe tapped in Denzel Dumfries' cross three minutes later before Valverde delivered the winner, leaving AEK 30th on three points. LIVERPOOL'S WINNING START ENDS Liverpool arrived in Istanbul with three wins from three but Vedat Muriqi's 79th-minute winner ended that run and earned Fenerbahce their first victory of the campaign. Trey Nyoni opened the scoring in the 25th minute, meeting a defensive header with a low volley that deflected off Kojo Peprah Oppong and wrongfooted Ederson. Mason Greenwood levelled four minutes later with a free kick that was heading wide before striking Jeremy Jacquet in the defensive wall and skidding past Alisson. Substitutes Cody Gakpo and Alexander Isak combined to restore Liverpool's lead in the 69th minute. Gakpo exchanged passes with Kostas Tsimikas before reaching the byline and delivering a cross for Isak to power a close-range header past Ederson. The advantage lasted four minutes. Following a short corner, N'Golo Kante crossed and Gakpo's glancing header diverted the ball away from Alisson, leaving Archie Brown to tap into an unguarded net at the far post. Brown then supplied the winner, looping the ball into the box after a long throw was headed back to him. Surrounded by three Liverpool defenders, Muriqi somehow headed past Alisson, wrapping up a poor night for Liverpool's defence. Andoni Iraola's side dropped to fifth with nine points, while Fenerbahce climbed to 19th on five.

Source: Reuters

DUBLIN, Nov 4 : Ireland coach Andy Farrell challenged his surprise selections to grab their opportunity after making changes to the side to take on Argentina in the Nations Championship on Friday. Scrumhalf Craig Casey was chosen ahead of Jamison Gibson-Park in Farrell's side for the test in Dublin. Former World Rugby Player of the Year Josh van der Flier was replaced in the starting lineup by Nick Timoney as the Ireland coach seeks to widen the selection pool with the 2027 World Cup in Australia less than a year away. “Craig deserves to play in a big game at the start of the season, to have the responsibility to be in charge of the week and take responsibility for how we play on Friday,” he told a press conference on Wednesday after naming his line-up. “We need him to be able to have the opportunity to do that. Plus he’s been playing pretty well himself. He knows the competition is there but he’s got the shirt so it’s up to him to make a good first impression.”

Timoney will be the openside flank. “Certainly last year he grabbed hold of the understanding of what he can bring and what international rugby is all about,” Farrell said of the 31-year-old Ulster loose forward, who made his test debut five years ago. “We saw a consistency within that. He brings a lot not just to our game but in different positions as well. Nick gets to wear the seven jersey for the first game and I’m sure Josh will have something to say about that in the coming weeks as well.” Ireland take on Fiji next weekend where Farrell is expected to give opportunities to others on the fringes of selection.  “You have to keep them hungry as well,” he said of squad players. “They will stay hungry no matter what, because that’s the type of people that they are, but you’ve got to make sure your squad is your strength, certainly for what’s coming up in the next 12 months. It’s important that we keep feeding that. “If ever a player feels comfortable, we’re failing the group, but we’ve not got those players anyway. I don’t think people are comfortable, just by their nature, but if you want to keep ambition growing as a group then you’ve got to keep the ambition within the individual,” Farrell added.

item.title: トランプ氏「イラン戦争が共和党に打撃」、 熱狂的支持を候補者に波及できず
item.description: [ワシントン ４日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ワシントン ４日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は４日、対イラン戦争が共和党の中間選挙での敗北の一因になったと認めながらも、戦争には価値があったとの考えを示した。

トランプ氏は記者団に対し「イランの件はやらなければならなかったし、今後も続けていく」と述べ、イランが核兵器を保有するのを阻止するために戦争は価値があったと主張した。

３日投開票の中間選挙では民主党が連邦議会上下両院の過半数を奪還。対イラン戦争を受けてガソリン価格が上昇したことが野党・民主党の大幅な議席増につながった要因の１つと受け止められている。

こうした中、バンス副大統領はこの日、「われわれが（中間選挙で）敗北した理由は戦争だ」とし、「それでも、戦争には価値があった、今後６年間にわたり上院（の多数派）を失う代償を払うだけの価値があったと主張したいなら、そうすればいい」とＸに投稿。トランプ大統領が進めた対イラン戦争との距離を置く姿勢を示し、有権者の厳しい審判は全面的にイラン戦争に原因があったとの認識を示した。

トランプ氏はこれについて問題視しない考えを示し、「その戦争について言えば、私なら違う対応はしなかった」と述べた。また、自分自身が中間選挙の投票対象だったら勝利していたと改めて主張。「選挙集会では信じられないほどの熱狂と支持があったが、その支持を候補者たちに移し替えることはできなかった」と語った。

FAST

Nov 4 : American goalie Connor Hellebuyck said "challenging circumstances involving my family" led him to request a trade from the Winnipeg Jets, addressing fans in a letter on Wednesday ahead of his return to the Canadian city. Hellebuyck, a three-time Vezina Trophy winner as the NHL's top goalie who also helped the US beat Canada in the gold medal game at the 2026 Olympics, sat out training camp and missed the opening weeks of the 2026-27 season before being sent to the New Jersey Devils in a blockbuster trade less than two weeks ago. "I know my decision to request a trade was disappointing and frustrating for many people, especially those who supported me throughout my career,” Hellebuyck wrote on Instagram ahead of the Devils' game at Winnipeg next Tuesday.  “I understand those feelings, and I want everyone to know it was an extremely difficult decision.”

Hellebuyck publicly confirmed in August that he wanted to leave Winnipeg, saying at the time that he had requested a move "several months ago". After helping the United States win Olympic gold, Hellebuyck and a number of his US teammates attended a White House reception hosted by President Donald Trump, who announced that the goalie would be awarded the Presidential Medal of Freedom. The 33-year-old Hellebuyck, who holds the Jets franchise’s record for most wins (345) and shutouts (45), faced a backlash in Canada for the White House visit and said in March that while he could handle the criticism he was upset his wife had borne the brunt of it. Hellebuyck, who is off to a 3-0 start with the Devils, thanked the entire Jets organization and the team's fans while also stopping short of divulging further details about his decision to seek a trade. “There were several considerations that went into my decision, including some very challenging circumstances involving my family,” Hellebuyck wrote. “After a lot of thought and discussion, we ultimately felt that making a change was the best thing for our family. "We've chosen to keep those personal circumstances private, and I hope people can respect that."

Source: Reuters

item.title: バンス副大統領、共和党敗北は「イラン戦争が原因」 トランプ氏と一線
item.description:
Phil Stewart
[ワシントン ４日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Phil Stewart

[ワシントン ４日 ロイター] - バンス米副大統領は４日、Ｘへの投稿で、トランプ大統領が進めた対イラン戦争との距離を置く姿勢を示し、その意義に疑問を呈するとともに、中間選挙で野党・民主党に議会支配を許した有権者の厳しい審判は全面的にイラン戦争に原因があったとの認識を示した。

バンス氏は「われわれが（中間選挙で）敗北した理由は戦争だ」とし、「それでも、戦争には価値があった、今後６年間にわたり上院（の多数派）を失う代償を払うだけの価値があったと主張したいなら、そうすればいい」とＸに投稿。過去に戦争終結を勧告したことについても「妥当な助言だった」とした。

３日投開票の中間選挙では、民主党が連邦議会上下両院の過半数を奪還。共和党の牙城にも食い込んで幅広い勝利を収め、有権者がトランプ大統領に厳しい審判を下した形となった。トランプ大統領が対イラン大規模軍事作戦の再開を検討する中、バンス氏が中間選挙の翌日にこうした異例の投稿を行ったことで、政権の判断が一段と複雑になる可能性がある。

この発言は国防総省高官、とりわけヘグセス国防長官の政治的立場にも疑問を投げかける。トランプ氏はヘグセス氏について、早い段階から戦争を支持していたと説明している。ヘグセス氏は議員からも厳しい批判を浴びている。

２０２４年の大統領選でトランプ氏を２期目に押し上げた保守地盤の有権者も民主党側へ大きく傾いた。背景には対イラン戦争への強い不満に加え、高止まりする生活費への不安など、トランプ政権の国政運営に対する不満があると見られる。

バンス氏はトランプ氏との見解の相違を小さく見せようと努め、トランプ氏自身もイラン戦争が中間選挙での共和党敗北の一因だったと認めていると指摘。ただ、トランプ氏の発言はより抑制的で、イラン戦争は敗因の１つにすぎないとの見方を示している。

トランプ氏はバンス氏の発言について記者団に問われ、良い発言だったとの考えを示し、「彼がどう感じているかは分かっている」と述べた。一方で、「われわれはイランによる核兵器の保有を阻止した」と述べ、戦争を擁護した。

ホワイトハウス顧問はロイターに対し、一部の当局者や職員はバンス氏の投稿を、外交政策を巡って大統領との一線を画し、戦争が国内経済に影響を及ぼしたと公に認めるものと受け止めたと語った。

＜２８年大統領選＞

バンス氏は、２０２８年大統領選の有力候補と目されている。バンス氏の対抗馬となる可能性があるルビオ国務長官は、中間選挙以降、沈黙を守っている。

事情に詳しい人物は、バンス氏の発言は２８年大統領選に向けた選挙運動の始まりと受け止めることもできると述べた。

ホワイトハウスの一部当局者は、バンス氏の投稿について事前に知らされていたと述べた。ただ、ホワイトハウス当局者の１人はロイターの質問に対し、ホワイトハウスの高官は、全員とは言わないまでも大半が不意を突かれたと述べた。

選挙後にイラン戦争が再燃するとの懸念がある中、仲介者らは終結に向けた取り組みを強めている。

バンス氏はここ数週間、イラン政府との交渉に一段と力を入れている。ただ、イラン側には、ウラン濃縮度をゼロに引き下げることなど、米国の要求を受け入れる意向を示す動きはほとんどない。

item.title: カナダ、米中間選挙後も対米通商方針維持 米高官と近く協議
item.description: [オタワ ４日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[オタワ ４日 ロイター] - カナダのルブラン対米貿易担当相は４日、米中間選挙の結果を受けても対米通商協議に対するカナダ政府の姿勢に変更はないとの認識を示し、近く米政権幹部と協議すると明らかにした。

３日投開票の米中間選挙では野党・民主党が上下両院の過半数を奪還。共和党の牙城にも食い込んで幅広い勝利を収め、有権者がトランプ大統領に厳しい審判を下した形となった。

ルブラン氏は記者団に対し「昨夜の選挙結果はある意味で興味深いものだが、カナダ政府の重点課題や取り組みが大きな影響を受けることはない」と述べ、数日以内にラトニック米商務長官、グリア米通商代表部（ＵＳＴＲ）代表と協議すると語った。

FAST

Nov 4 : Rory McIlroy backed criticism of LIV Golf on Wednesday, saying the Saudi-backed breakaway league had taken players and sponsors from rival tours and turned professional golf into an "arms race". McIlroy said he agreed with DP World Tour Chief Executive Guy Kinnings' assertion that LIV had sought to undermine the European circuit, pointing to comments made by people involved with the league at this year's Masters about wanting to destroy the tour. "They took players; they took sponsors; they turned professional golf into an arms race," the Northern Irishman told reporters ahead of the Abu Dhabi Championship. "They were going around Augusta saying they wanted to destroy The European Tour. Yeah, I agree with everything."

McIlroy acknowledged that LIV's investment had brought benefits, including the creation of the International Series on the Asian Tour, but said the latter had ultimately been left without the support it needed. "Where did that leave the Asian Tour? They left them high and dry," he said, adding that the tour had since returned to the fold through partnerships with the PGA Tour and DP World Tour. The six-times major champion said LIV's financial model was always likely to face difficulties if investors failed to see a return or decided to redirect their money elsewhere. Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund, which has invested more than $5 billion in LIV since its launch in 2022, is ending its financial backing after the 2026 season. LIV filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection in September and has secured a proposed financing commitment of up to $300 million from BC Partners Credit as it seeks to restructure ahead of 2027. McIlroy, 37, added the disruption caused by the breakaway league could ultimately leave men's golf on a more sustainable footing. "For long-term sustainability for men's professional golf, I think we are in a much better spot," he said.

Source: Reuters

item.title: ロ通販大手オゾン物流拠点で火災、ウクライナのドローン攻撃受け
item.description: [４日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[４日 ロイター] - ウクライナによるドローン（無人機）攻撃により、ロシア南部のアディゲ共和国アディゲイスクにある電子商取引大手オゾンの物流拠点で火災が発生した。同社と地域当局者が４日明らかにした。

アディゲイスクにあるオゾンの施設が標的とされたのは今回が２回目となる。ウクライナは７月以降、ロシアの経済と戦争遂行能力に打撃を与えるため、同社および競合他社のワイルドベリーズが運営する数十カ所の巨大倉庫を攻撃しており、今回はその一連の攻撃の一環とみられる。

ロシアもウクライナの商業施設に対して同様の攻撃を行っており、地上戦線の状況が概ね膠着状態にある一方で、ここ数カ月、双方が空戦を激化させている。米国の仲介で１１月１０─１１日にアラブ首長国連邦（ＵＡＥ）のアブダビで行われる和平協議を前に、ロシアは３日、ウクライナのエネルギーインフラに対し複数回にわたる大規模な波状攻撃を実施。ウクライナも２日、中部ヤロスラブリの石油精製施設を攻撃した。

オゾンは、今回の攻撃による死傷者は確認されておらず、施設の従業員は全員避難したと述べた。今回の攻撃に先立ち、オゾンは先週発表した決算で、１１カ所の施設へのドローン攻撃により３０１億ルーブル（３億６７００万ドル）の損失が発生する見込みだと明らかにしていた。

item.title: ＥＣＢ総裁、気候変動対策呼びかけ ＣＯＰ３１首脳会議にらみ
item.description: [フランクフルト ４日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[フランクフルト ４日 ロイター] - 欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）のラガルド総裁は４日、欧州で夏の猛暑に伴う大きな被害が発生したことを踏まえ、気候変動関連の対策を強めるよう欧州連合（ＥＵ）に呼びかけた。国連気候変動枠組み条約第３１回締約国会議（ＣＯＰ３１）首脳会議が来週トルコで開かれるのを前にした発言で、関連した保険の整備や電力インフラへの投資拡大、企業による自家発電強化を挙げた。

ロイターが確認した内部文書によると、ＥＵはＣＯＰ３１首脳会議で、温室効果ガス排出削減に向けた「パッケージ」に関する合意をまとめたい考えだ。

ラガルド氏はブログで「夏の異常気象が常態化しつつある中、欧州は先を見据えて準備を進め、経済的損失を防ぐ必要がある」と述べた。熱波や山火事などで欧州の経済やエネルギー面で弱点が示されており、温暖化で問題が深刻化しかねないと主張した。

ラガルド氏は、欧州での災害損失のうち保険でカバーされてきたのは４分の１に過ぎないと指摘。気候災害に備えた官民共同の再保険の仕組みづくりの必要性を強調した。送電網を拡充する投資が全体としてのコスト削減につながるとしたほか、太陽光発電の活用に向けた蓄電能力の向上、自家発電設備の保有企業が需要ひっ迫の際に供給支援するようなルールづくりを提言した。

ラガルド氏は、民間部門からの多くの投資が必要だとし、資金調達面でのＥＣＢの施策については言及しなかった。ラガルド氏は来年２月７日に退任することを発表している。

FAST

HOUSTON/NEW YORK, Nov 4 : Texas' red-hot data center industry has been plunged into uncertainty by governor-elect Gina Hinojosa's pledge to crack down on the rapid growth of server warehouse projects. Hinojosa, who ousted Republican Greg Abbott in a dramatic upset on Tuesday, hammered that message in the final weeks of her campaign, calling for a statewide moratorium and vowing days before the vote to “stop the data center takeover.” With plentiful energy supplies, relatively cheap land and a pro-business policy, Texas has become one of the hottest regions for data center development in recent years. Big Tech companies including Meta, Google and Microsoft have announced major data center projects in the state over the past two years.  But growing opposition from rural communities and a surge in requests to connect to the state’s power grid had pushed even the Republican governor, Abbott, to order a pause on data center permits earlier this year.

Before the election, Hinojosa said she would take the crackdown on data centers a step further by banning all data center approvals until the state legislature passes laws "to protect Texans, so that Texans have a seat at the table to decide if and how data centers come into our community." The data center industry had already come under pressure before the midterms. On August 3, Abbott became one of the first Republican governors in the US to halt the connection of new data centers to the state's electric grid. He also ordered a comprehensive audit of the projects, with a focus on power demand, environmental impacts and tax breaks given to developers.  The move represented a dramatic shift in Abbott's approach to data centers, which he had supported just months earlier. By the time Texas halted data centers connecting to its grid, state grid operator ERCOT said it was tracking more than 400 gigawatts of data center projects - roughly equivalent to what it would take to power the entire US South - seeking to connect to the grid. Abbott's about-face also threw tens of billions of dollars of data center projects planned in Texas into jeopardy and raised doubts over whether hundreds of millions in grid deposits paid by data centers seeking to connect to the grid would be returned. Since ordering the audit, Abbott has also taken actions to penalize data center water violations retroactively and temporarily banned the state from issuing air permits for the projects. Abbott, however, did not issue a formal moratorium on data centers, which Hinojosa has vowed to do. Certain measures by Abbott also had a near-term expiration date, like the air permit ban and the audit, which was expected to conclude at the end of 2026. “The data centers connect economic development to everyday concerns,” University of Houston political scientist Brandon Rottinghaus said a day before the vote, citing electricity bills, water supplies and property rights. Polling showed rural voters, who are “at the epicenter of so many of these fights,” were unhappy with the spread of data centers heading into the election, he said. Some 42 per cent of registered voters in a Reuters/Ipsos poll published this week said limiting the construction of data centers used to power AI was very important or the most important issue for them. Some 76 per cent of voters nationwide said they opposed the construction of a new data center in their community, according to an NBC and SSRS exit poll. Ahead of the vote, a University of Houston poll in October found that 79 per cent of likely Texas voters supported limits on the number of data centers that can be built in the state. "Data centers in space looking pretty appealing right now," Elon Musk, who supported Abbott in the election and had spent $158 million to promote Texas Republican Senate candidate Ken Paxton alone, wrote early Wednesday on X.

Source: Reuters

Nov 5 : Japan plans to seek earlier access to information on undisclosed software vulnerabilities from US artificial intelligence developers and other overseas technology firms as it moves to strengthen defences against rising cyberattacks, the Nikkei newspaper reported on Thursday. The government is expected to present an emergency cybersecurity package at a ministerial meeting that could be convened as early as Friday, the report added. In late October, Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi instructed officials to devise steps to bolster cyber defences following a recent increase in cyberattacks, according to Nikkei. Government and corporate websites in several countries were disrupted in October after the disclosure of critical vulnerabilities in the PHP programming language that underpins much of the internet, prompting millions of hacking attempts and forcing website operators to protect or temporarily shut down their systems.

FAST

Nov 4 : Democrats' midterm election sweep sent shares in US tech giants soaring on Wednesday as investors bet that potential curbs on new data-center construction could cement their grip on scarce computing power while easing pressure on strained cash flows. Shares of Amazon surged 7.4 per cent to a three-month high while Meta Platforms, Alphabet and Microsoft gained between 2 per cent and 6.3 per cent, powering a rally on Wall Street after days of selling fueled by fears over the AI boom's soaring costs. Apple, which has avoided Big Tech's massive AI spending but is feeling the sting of an AI-fueled surge in memory chip prices, jumped nearly 7 per cent to a record high. If the gains hold, the five companies are on course to add more than $750 billion in combined market value.

The rally marks a sharp reversal for the battered cloud giants after their quarterly earnings showed how the AI infrastructure race was turning once cash-rich, debt-light companies into heavy spenders reliant on borrowing. Microsoft was the notable exception, with $18.6 billion in cash flow. The gains followed landslide midterm victories for Democrats who oppose data centers, including in Texas, likely accelerating a backlash against the power-hungry, water-intensive and noisy facilities that are at the heart of the AI boom but increasingly unpopular with local communities. "Conceptually, post-election, there may be a bit of a slowdown or some bumps in the road for future data-center build-out," said Art Hogan, chief market strategist at B. Riley Wealth. "The hyperscalers (large tech companies) already have data centers, so those assets are more valuable now because there's not going to be an overbuild of data centers. Also, if there's a slower pace of data-center build-out, then there's going to be a slower pace of CapEx spending. That certainly would impact the hyperscalers." The tech giants have been building capacity at a blistering pace, with plans to spend more than $740 billion this year, up from roughly $400 billion last year. That far outstrips smaller AI cloud rivals such as CoreWeave and Nebius. Shares of smaller players including Applied Digital and Iren plunged between 6 per cent and 13 per cent on fears that curbs on data-center construction could derail their debt-fueled expansion plans. The companies have been spending several times their revenue to meet a swelling backlog of orders. "The biggest worry of the night for tech investors and the AI trade was around the state of Texas, where ~25 per cent-30 per cent of data-center gigawatts and capacity will come from," said Dan Ives, senior managing director and tech analyst at Yorkville Ives. "Now it will happen at a more measured pace, which is likely a good thing in the eyes of many investors."

Source: Reuters

JERUSALEM: Benjamin Netanyahu 's political rivals seize d on Democrats' capture of the US Congress as proof that he had squandered generations of bipartisan American support for Israel, as they seek a chance to form a government without him. Democrats won majorities in both the Senate and Ho us e in Tuesday's (Nov 3) midterm election, in a scathing rebuke to US President Donald Trump fuelled in part by deep fr us tration over the unpopular US -Israeli war on Iran. The US vote took place j us t a week after an Israeli election, when Netanyahu 's right-wing coalition lost its parliamentary majority but performed well enough to deny his main opponent Gadi Eisenkot a clear path to unseat him. Israeli President Isaac Herzog is due to hold talks on Wednesday and Thursday with party representatives before tasking one of the two men with forming the next government. Meanwhile Netanyahu remains prime minister as a caretaker.

US SUPPORT WAVERS FOR LONGSTANDING ALLY The United States has been Israel's staunchest ally for generations under presidents of both parties, providing billions of dollars a year in military aid since the 1970s. But unlike previo us leaders who assiduo us ly courted Democrats and Republicans alike, Netanyahu has openly backed Republicans. Support for Israel among Democrats and some Republicans wavered after Israel launched its military assault in Gaza following the 2023 Hamas attack, and fell further t his year since Trump and Netanyahu ordered a joint attack on Iran. Some Democratic candidates made criticism of American military aid to Israel a prominent campaign argument. On Tuesday, Trump, who had endorsed Netanyahu , made an election-day pledge to halt US$4 billion in annual funding to Israel, a move he said would take away a "bad talking point" us ed by Democrats. Yair Golan, head of Israel's centre-left opposition Democrats party, said on X that the US midterm election results "reveal j us t how toxic Netanyahu is among both Democrats and Republicans". Centrist opposition leader Yair Lapid said the results showed "Israel cannot afford" for Netanyahu to remain in office. "It endangers our security, it jeopardises our democracy, and it will ruin our standing on the global stage," Lapid said in a social media post.

Netanyahu has so far remained silent about the outcome of the US vote. His office did not respond to a request for comment. It could be weeks or months before it becomes clear whether it is Netanyahu or Eisenkot who ultimately faces the task of repairing the relationship. Whichever candidate is chosen first m us t build a new coalition or the other will be given an opportunity. If both fail, a new election would be called. Meanwhile, Udi Sommer, a professor of political science at Tel Aviv University, predicted that the incoming Democratic-controlled US Congress would be the most adversarial towards Israel in its his tory. Although most power over foreign policy still resides with the president, Democrats could apply pressure through hearings, congress ional oversight and budgetary measures, he said. "The Democratic landslide and the Republican wipeout encapsulate the next chapter in US -Israel relations," Sommer said.

Source: Reuters/fs

FAST

WASHINGTON, Nov 4 : The crypto industry's roughly $200 million spending spree this election stumbled Tuesday, as some of its most expensive and high-profile targets, including the Senate race in Ohio, did not go its way. While the industry won most of the races it targeted, those losses raised questions among lobbyists about whether it had backed the right candidates.  The greatest blow for the industry came in Ohio, where Democrat and crypto skeptic Sherrod Brown decisively won his race to return to the Senate, despite crypto political action committees spending more than $60 million to defeat him.  The race was one of the most expensive in the Senate's history. Strategists viewed it as a major test of crypto's political clout after the Senate in September voted against advancing major crypto legislation known as the Clarity Act due to opposition from Democrats, in a blow for an industry that has grown close to President Donald Trump.

Some progressive Democratic primary candidates also successfully attacked opponents over their crypto ties. "We see this as souring the political environment for crypto," said Jaret Seiberg, an analyst with TD Cowen, in a note on Tuesday. The leading industry super PAC, Fairshake, notched one high-profile victory, as it and its affiliates spent at least $13.5 million to defeat Nebraska independent Senate candidate Dan Osborn, a former labor union leader. Osborn lost to Republican Senator Pete Ricketts, who voted for the Clarity Act.  “As the biggest spender in the Nebraska Senate race, we’re proud to have helped Sen. Ricketts weather the waves of a hard-fought cycle," said Geoff Vetter, a spokesperson for Fairshake.  Fairshake, whose chief backers include Coinbase, Ripple and venture capital firm Andreessen Horowitz, threw its financial heft behind 32 House candidates — 19 Republicans and 13 Democrats — whom it considered supporters of the industry's priorities.  So far, it has won 29 of the 34 races it spent on, with several races not yet called. Of the six House candidates on whom Fairshake spent $1 million or more, so far it has won three.  "Newly elected and current members will have a choice: protect consumers and American jobs or fight progress," Fairshake's Vetter said.   The crypto industry has spent roughly half a billion dollars over the past two election cycles to build a bipartisan coalition of congressional allies to advance its interests.  In 2024, it helped elect dozens of crypto-friendly lawmakers who later came together to pass a law to help promote adoption of dollar-backed tokens known as stablecoins. The Clarity Act's defeat was a major setback, and with Democrats taking Congress, the industry now faces oversight and potential investigations, particularly its ties to Trump.  Cryptocurrencies posted overnight losses on the results, but recovered on Wednesday. Bitcoin, the world's largest cryptocurrency, was last up 3.1 per cent above $80,000.  Crypto executives frequently say the long-term trend is still favorable. "Where crypto is today compared to we were two years ago is night and day," said Stu Alderoty, chief legal officer at Ripple, speaking before the results. However, on the possibility of Democratic probes into Trump's crypto business dealings, he said: "I think the writing is on the wall.”

(Additional reporting by Dawn Kopecki; editing by David Gaffen)

Source: Reuters

item.title: AI data center stocks dip, renewables surge after Democrat sweep in US midterm elections
item.description: AI data centre stocks declined while renewable energy and healthcare shares rallied after Democrats won control of Congress in the US midterm elections. Investors assessed the possibility of tighter AI oversight and continued clean energy support. Defence contractors and prison operators fell amid concerns over changing government spending and immigration policies.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Data center stocks slid on Wednesday, while clean-energy shares rallied after Democrats seized control of Congress, prompting investors to reposition for tougher scrutiny of the AI boom and a shift in policy priorities.The Democratic sweep, which included victories in traditional Republican strongholds and key data-center hubs Texas and Georgia, will usher in divided government in Washington and raises the prospect of greater congressional oversight of industries that benefited from Republican control.Market reaction rippled across AI-linked stocks, renewables, healthcare companies, defense contractors and prison operators.DATA CENTER STOCKSData center operators lost ground, with Core Scientific down 3.5% and Iren down 3.6%. Applied Digital and CoreWeave fell 2.4% and 3.8%, respectively.The data center boom sparked public backlash this year, raising concerns that tighter Democratic oversight could slow investment just as investors grow wary of soaring AI spending and uncertain returns.Though analysts doubt any legislation could meaningfully stall data center construction, a Democratic-led Congress increases prospects of more hearings and investigations related to the AI buildout. AI has been an enormous engine powering the US economy, so any curbs on its future development could threaten to put the brakes on growth, said Kit Rees, investment strategist at Quilter.CLEAN ENERGYA Democratic sweep could bolster expectations for continued federal support for clean energy while speeding approvals for energy and infrastructure projects.Democrats plan to scrutinize the Trump administration's efforts to roll back emissions rules and could use the Congressional Review Act to overturn regulations that make it easier to sell gas-powered trucks and SUVs.Shares of solar maker First Solar gained 7%, residential solar installer Sunrun added 6.1% and inverter maker Enphase Energy was up 3.6%. Clean-power developer NextEra Energy inched 2.3% higher. The more that oil and gas prices rise, the bigger the incentive, the bigger the economic incentive to roll out clean energy, said Paul Jackson, global market strategist for EMEA at Invesco.Europe's Vestas and Orsted rose 4.3% and 6.4%, respectively, while Portugal's EDP Renewables was up 2.3%.ELON MUSK-LED COMPANIESShares of Elon Musk's rocket and space technology company SpaceX dropped 5.2%, while EV maker Tesla was down 4.9%. It puts into doubt a potential merger between SpaceX and Tesla. While Congress cannot stop a merger, they could slow it down via extra scrutiny, said Kathleen Brooks, research director at XTB. Musk had poured hundreds of millions into the Republican Party ahead of these elections...we could see stocks linked to Musk struggle now that his political enemies have won back control of Congress. Trump Media & Technology Group, majority-owned by Trump, dropped 7.7%.DEFENSE STOCKSDefense contractors such as Northrop Grumman fell 2.7%, while RTX, Lockheed Martin and L3Harris lost over 2% each. The sector had been underpinned by expectations that the $1.5-trillion budget request by Trump would not face headwinds in a Republican-dominated Congress.However, in a Democrat-led Congress, analysts project the funding could fall short of expectations.HEALTH INSURERS AND HOSPITAL OPERATORSShares of hospital operators such as HCA Healthcare and Universal Health Services gained 5.4% and 3.4%, respectively.Insurers such as Centene rose 4.7% and Elevance was marginally higher.Democrats have pushed for universal healthcare policies that could mean more government spending allocated to the sector.BNP Paribas economist Anis Bensaidani said Democrats may lack the numbers to pass legislation restoring major parts of the Affordable Care Act, but they could still win concessions while negotiating over defense spending and government funding.PRISON OPERATORSPrison operators such as GEO Group and CoreCivic fell 6.2% and 5.7%, respectively. The two stocks have rallied sharply since Trump won the presidency two years ago, as his clampdown on illegal immigration boosted the need for detention facilities.

item.description:
Neil J Kanatt Waylon Cunningham
[４日 ロイター] - 米ファストフードチェーン大手マ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
マクドナルド7─9月期、米で減収　生活費高騰で外食控え 1:26 配信

２０２５年８月撮影　REUTERS/Dado Ruvic（ロイター） Neil J Kanatt　Waylon Cunningham

[４日　ロイター] - 米ファストフードチェーン大手マクドナルドが４日発表した２０２６年第３・四半期（２６年７─９月期）決算は、主要市場の米国で既存店売上高が前年同期比０．２％減と、６四半期ぶりの減少となった。生活費の高騰で消費者が外食を控える傾向が続いたことが響いた。より安価なメニューを持つ同業との競争も激化している。

ＬＳＥＧがまとめたアナリスト予想は０．１％減だった。

世界全体の既存店売上高は１．５％増で、市場予想と同程度だった。調整後１株当たり利益は３．５７ドル。前年同期の３．２２ドルから増加し、予想の３．３８ドルを上回った。営業コスト・経費が約４％減少したことが寄与した。

マクドナルドは３ドル以下のメニューや４ドルの朝食セットなど低所得層向けに「バリューメニュー」を展開してきたが、情報分析会社Ｐｌａｃｅｒ．ａｉのデータによると、来店客数は４．６％減だったという。

マクドナルドのクリス・ケンプチンスキ最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は、価格面での取り組みを進め、足元では改善が見られていると明らかにした。イアン・ボーデン最高財務責任者（ＣＦＯ）は９月下旬の投資家向けイベントで、９月単月の売上高はプラスに復調するとの見通しを示していた。

ロイター 関連リンク アングル：米中間選挙の民主勝利、市場に新たな波乱　外交・財政リスク警戒 米民主党が上下両院で過半数の見通し：識者はこうみる アングル：世界市場は既にぜい弱、ＡＩにもひび割れ 焦点：オープンＡＩの甘いセキュリティー管理、従業員は以前から警鐘 コラム：安全資産性薄まる金　リスクオフでも買われず 11/5(木) 1:26 最終更新 ロイター

FAST

NEW YORK, Nov 4 : The dollar retreated on Wednesday but was off its earlier lows after a sweeping victory by Democrats in the US midterm elections removed a source of uncertainty for the market while investors gauged the potential for regulatory changes. Democrats seized control of both the Senate and House of Representatives on Tuesday, scoring sweeping victories in some Republican strongholds for the first time in generations as tens of millions of voters delivered a sharp rebuke to President Donald Trump. The outsized win eased concerns about potentially contested results, although it brought the prospect of divided government and legislative gridlock between a Republican White House and a Democratic Congress, as the US grapples with the Iran war and an AI boom that has fuelled both economic growth and inflation. US stocks rallied, with the S&P 500 up about 2 per cent, while crude prices plummeted as investors waited for Washington's next move in the US-Israeli war with Iran.

"It's a risk-on feeling. Maybe we're just seeing a bit of a combination of sell the news, buy the fact, relief that we're not going to be in a quagmire over rigged election results," said Erik Bregar, director of FX and precious metals risk management at Silver Gold Bull in Toronto. "Fundamentally, you could still see more of the AI concerns, given the Democrat positioning on data centers and all. But for the time being, markets are relieved that Trump's not going to fight this, and when we see risk-on across the board, that's broadly dollar negative." DOLLAR INDEX FALLS, EURO CLIMBS The dollar index, which measures the greenback against a basket of currencies, fell 0.25 per cent to 101.60 after earlier falling to 101.21, its lowest since September 30. The euro was up 0.21 per cent at $1.1217 after climbing to $1.1272, its highest since October 6. Despite the political shift in the US, expectations for the Federal Reserve's interest rate path remained largely intact. Markets are pricing in an 81.2 per cent chance for a rate increase of at least 25 basis points from the Fed at its December meeting, according to CME FedWatch, up from 77.4 per cent in the prior session. PAYROLLS BEAT EXPECTATIONS The election results largely overshadowed a flurry of US economic data. The ADP National Employment Report showed US private payrolls rose by 86,000 jobs in October, above the 69,000 estimate of economists polled by Reuters. The report was the latest in a string of labor market data this week, which will wind up on Friday with the release of the government's payrolls report. A separate report from the Institute for Supply Management said its non-manufacturing Purchasing Managers Index dipped to 54.5 last month, down from 54.9 in September. The latest reading was slightly below economists' 54.8 estimate but above the 50 threshold that signifies expansion. Sterling was up 0.38 per cent at $1.3462, after rising to a more than seven-week high of $1.3503 ahead of the Bank of England's policy announcement on Thursday. The pound was poised for its sixth straight daily gain, its longest run higher since an eight-session streak that ended on July 6. The Bank of England is expected to bow to inflation pressure from soaring energy costs and raise interest rates, although it may push back against investors' bets that several more increases will follow next year. Against the Japanese yen, the dollar weakened 0.14 per cent to 158.43.

Source: Reuters

item.title: 米共和党ジョンソン下院議長、少数党院内総務選に不出馬＝関係筋
item.description:
David Morgan
[ワシントン ４日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
David Morgan

[ワシントン ４日 ロイター] - 米共和党のジョンソン下院議長は、３日投開票の中間選挙で共和党が下院の多数派を失ったことを受け、下院共和党トップの少数党院内総務選に立候補しない意向を固めた。関係筋が４日、明らかにした。

関係筋によると、ジョンソン氏は４日朝、スタッフに決定を伝えた。ジョンソン氏は３年前に下院議長に就任して以降、２１８対２１４の僅差だった共和党多数派の取りまとめに苦慮していた。

トランプ大統領は記者団に対し、共和党の指導部選には関与しないとの考えを示した上で、「（ジョンソン）議長はすばらしかった。彼の部下たちもすばらしかった。みんな良い人たちだ」と語った。

こうした中、１０日に実施される見通しの党内選挙で、オハイオ州選出の保守強硬派ジム・ジョーダン議員とスカリス下院院内総務は、少数党院内総務ポストを目指す方針を表明した。

ジョーダン氏は同僚議員への書簡で立候補を表明。法と秩序、減税、伝統的価値観を優先課題として挙げ、「われわれが多数派を取り戻すには、これらの原則を実行する能力に対する有権者の信頼を回復しなければならない」と述べた。

スカリス氏も同僚議員への書簡で、「真の米国」に暮らす人々と対話し、その意見を基に社会保障や高齢者向け公的医療保険（メディケア）など主要課題に関する法案を策定するための作業部会を設置すると提案。「われわれには大きな課題が待ち受けており、実績のあるリーダーシップが今ほど必要とされている時はない」と述べた。

ジョーダン氏とスカリス氏は、２０２３年に共和党強硬派がマッカーシー氏を下院議長の座から追放した後、それぞれ議長選に立候補したが、いずれも失敗に終わった。

item.title: 世界企業、コストや関税巡る短期見通し変わらず 民主が米議会掌握でも
item.description:
Christoph Steitz Yuka Obayashi Emanuele Berro
[フランクフルト／東京／...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
世界企業、コストや関税巡る短期見通し変わらず　民主が米議会掌握でも 1:12 配信

3月4日、米カリフォルニア州ロサンゼルス港のターミナルで撮影。REUTERS/Mike Blake（ロイター） Christoph Steitz　Yuka Obayashi　Emanuele Berro

[フランクフルト／東京／グダニスク ４日 ロイター] - 世界の企業各社は４日、エネルギーや原材料のコスト上昇、米消費者の購買力の低下に苦しむ中、米連邦議会の民主党による掌握が短期的な見通しを変える可能性は低いとの見方を示した。一方で、政治的安定が見込まれることを歓迎する声もあった。

３日投開票の米中間選挙では、民主党が上下両院の過半数を奪還した。共和党の牙城にも食い込んで幅広い勝利を収め、有権者がトランプ大統領に厳しい審判を下した形となった。

だが、関税措置やエネルギー価格、インフレ、消費者信頼感など、世界中の企業を揺るがしている問題に対して、今回の結果が何を意味するのかを見極めるには時期尚早だ。

ドイツの自動車部品大手コンチネンタルのローランド・ウェルツバッハー最高財務責任者（ＣＦＯ）は「米国で事業を展開する企業としてわれわれに必要なのは、政治的安定と信頼できる経済の枠組みだ。これらを支えるあらゆる動きは歓迎する」と指摘。「これが当社や経済全体にとって具体的に何を意味するのかはまだ不明だが、安定をもたらすという点では良いことだ」と述べた。

アナリストらは、米国の消費者のコストを押し上げてきた貿易戦争への回帰を避けるため、ホワイトハウスへの圧力が強まる可能性があると指摘。一方、欧州の一部メーカーは、トランプ氏の高い輸入関税が即座に実質的に緩和されることはほとんど期待できないとみている。

ドイツ機械工業連盟（ＶＤＭＡ）で北米担当の通商政策顧問を務めるアンドリュー・アデア氏は、トランプ政権は主に議会の承認を必要としない大統領権限を通じて関税政策を進めてきたため、こうした権限は依然として維持されるとの見方を示した。

同氏は、議会は既存の関税の撤回を模索する可能性はあるものの、そうした法案は大きな政治的ハードルに直面し、最終的に大統領に拒否権を行使される可能性があると指摘。「このため、国内政治が短期的に事業環境に直接影響を及ぼすとは予想していない」と語った。

今回の選挙結果は、トランプ氏の強硬な移民・通商政策によって損なわれてきた米国の対外的なイメージを改善させる可能性もある。トランプ氏の就任以降、訪米者数は大きく落ち込んでいる。

独フランクフルト空港運営会社フラポートのステファン・シュルテＣＥＯは「関税を巡る反発が和らぎ、旅行への意欲が高まる可能性があり、航空業界にかなりプラスの影響を与えるはずだ」としつつ、「ただ、その重要性を過大評価するつもりはない」と述べた。

ロイター 関連リンク アングル：民主勝利でもトランプ氏は関税路線堅持、政策転換シナリオ見込めず 焦点：トランプ氏、関税政策を転換　法的根拠強め「強固な壁」 コラム：トランプ関税、当初の懸念より影響が限定的な理由 アングル：トランプ関税で変わる米国のメニュー、国産ワインへの切り替え進む コラム：相互関税への違憲判決とドル円・クロス円の行方＝内田稔氏 11/5(木) 1:12 最終更新 ロイター

item.title: AI boom draws chip supply from other end-markets, Siltronic CEO says
item.description: Nov 4 : An AI chip boom is redirecting semiconductor supply toward data centres and away from smartphones and PCs, constraining some end markets, Siltronic CEO Michael Heckmeier said on Wednesday.Siltronic, which makes silicon wafers used in semiconductors, raised its annual sales forecast for the second time

item.content:encoded:

AI boom draws chip supply from other end-markets, Siltronic CEO says

"AI Chips" words and a keyboard in this illustration taken October 19, 2026. REUTERS/Dado Ruvic/Illustration

FAST

Nov 4 : An AI chip boom is redirecting semiconductor supply toward data centres and away from smartphones and PCs, constraining some end markets, Siltronic CEO Michael Heckmeier said on Wednesday. Siltronic, which makes silicon wafers used in semiconductors, raised its annual sales forecast for the second time this year on Wednesday, citing stronger demand for its wafers. AI-linked demand has become the chip industry's main growth engine, but Heckmeier told Reuters in an interview that some other semiconductor end markets could grow faster if more chips were available. "It's not that AI is offsetting certain weaknesses," Heckmeier said. "It's more AI is generating a certain weakness."

Demand for AI-related chips remains so strong that semiconductor manufacturers are allocating more supply to those applications, leaving less capacity for other end markets. "When our customers have the choice to sell their chips to different segments, they will always send them to the ones that pay best," he said. "The pockets of the AI players, particularly the hyperscalers, are the deepest." The trend has made AI servers the industry's main growth engine, with the impact extending beyond higher server volumes. Heckmeier said AI server farms consume roughly three to four times more silicon area than traditional servers, boosting demand for advanced wafers Any moderation in AI demand would not necessarily derail the industry's growth, Heckmeier said, because capacity could flow back to smartphones, PCs and other markets where underlying demand remains solid. "We don't see it at all today," Heckmeier said of any slowdown in AI demand. "But even if it came, we feel there is a natural balance in the system that the overall growth dynamics could go on."

Source: Reuters

item.title: アングル：民主党の議会制圧、ＦＲＢ独立性を強化 ウォーシュ議長に新たな試練
item.description:
Howard Schneider
[ワシントン ４日 ロイター] - 中間選挙での民主党の圧勝、とりわけ米上院の支配権...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
アングル：民主党の議会制圧、ＦＲＢ独立性を強化　ウォーシュ議長に新たな試練 1:09 配信

2025年9月17日撮影。米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）。REUTERS/Ken Cedeno/File Photo（ロイター） Howard Schneider

[ワシントン ４日 ロイター] - 中間選挙での民主党の圧勝、とりわけ米上院の支配権獲得は、米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）への介入を図るトランプ大統領に対し、ＦＲＢの立場を強める結果となる。上院が人事承認権を握ることは、トランプ氏が中央銀行にこれ以上の盟友を送り込むことへの大きな歯止めとなる。

これは、ウォーシュ議長にとっても新たな頭痛の種になりかねない。主要な監督委員会が民主党の手に渡り、上院銀行委員会の場合、ウォーシュ氏に厳しい批判を向けてきたマサチューセッツ州選出のエリザベス・ウォーレン上院議員（民主党）が、トランプ氏の盟友でウォーシュ氏を支持するサウスカロライナ州選出のティム・スコット氏に代わって委員長に就く可能性が高いためだ。

元ＦＲＢ理事ラリー・メイヤー氏の会社であるマネタリー・ポリシー・アナリティクスのエコノミストらは、民主党の上院勝利の影響について、ウォーシュ氏は「議長就任で民主党からの支持を得られなかった。発信を減らし、対外的な透明性が低下した中銀運営を進める中で、敵対的な質問がウォーシュ氏の姿勢を試すことになりかねない」と記した。

生活費問題を前面に掲げて選挙戦を展開した民主党には、中央銀行のインフレ抑制という使命を巡ってウォーシュ氏に圧力をかける動機がある。一方、同委員会は重要と見なす問題を調査する広い余地を持つことになる。ウォーレン氏の場合、ウォーシュ氏がＦＲＢ議長に就任する過程で数億ドルの資産を不透明な形で処理したことなどがそれに当たる。

トランプ氏にとって、議会の新たな力学は、７人で構成するＦＲＢ理事会にさらに盟友を据えようとする取り組みを直接阻むものだ。理事のうち３人はバイデン前大統領が任命した。トランプ氏とバイデン氏から連続して任命されながら、今は大統領と対立するパウエル前議長も、依然として理事にとどまっている。

大統領はこの顔ぶれを「敵対的」「党派的」と呼び、ＦＲＢは金利を大幅に引き下げる必要があると主張してきた。反対に、ウォーシュ氏を含む政策当局者は、高インフレを抑えるために利上げを続けてきた。

トランプ氏によるリサ・クック理事の解任の試みは続いている。数週間以内にホワイトハウスの行政手続きが行われる見通しで、クック氏がＦＲＢに任命される前の住宅ローン申請の誤りを巡り、トランプ氏が解任する「正当な理由」があると表明する下地を整えるものとみられる。

これに対しては訴訟が起こされる公算が大きい。最高裁は既に一度、クック氏の排除を図る試みに対しトランプ氏に不利な判断を下している。仮に最終的に解任に成功したとしても、民主党主導の上院が後任候補を承認する見込みはほとんどない。

共和党が支配する機関でさえ、トランプ氏の１期目には極端と見なされたＦＲＢ人事を拒否した。今年は、ノースカロライナ州選出のトム・ティリス上院議員（共和党）が、政権がパウエル氏に対する刑事捜査を取り下げるまでウォーシュ氏の指名を保留した経緯がある。トランプ氏から圧力を受けた後、ティリス氏は再選出馬を見送り、同州は民主党のロイ・クーパー氏が制した。

ＦＲＢ政治を扱った著書を持つパイロット・ウェーブ・ホールディングスのパートナー、マーク・スピンデル氏は、今回の選挙の影響に関する分析で、民主党が支配する上院は「今後のトランプ氏の指名候補を巡る承認環境を変え、ＦＲＢに異なる程度の政治的支援を与える可能性がある」と記した。ＦＲＢの独立性は「常に部分的に議会に依存してきた。上院からの制度的な支援は、政策当局者が政治的圧力ではなくインフレや雇用に基づいて決定を下す余地がどれだけあるかに影響を与え得る」と指摘した。

上院の委員会に加え、下院金融サービス委員会も民主党が支配することで、政権や現職のミシェル・ボウマン監督担当副議長が推し進める銀行・規制改革を巡る混乱も招きかねない。ＦＲＢはステーブルコインを規制する「ジーニアス法」などに関する規則を策定中で、ボウマン氏は最近、ＦＲＢの銀行監督体制の統合を打ち出した。

ロイター 関連リンク 米民主党が上下両院で過半数の見通し：識者はこうみる アングル：トランプ氏の「信任投票」化戦略、共和党内に懐疑論も アングル：ムスリム候補者をやり玉に、米中間選挙でイスラム教を争点化する共和党 アングル：米中間選挙が事実上の最終盤入り、トランプ氏の共和党に暗雲 アングル：テキサス州知事も一転慎重化、強まるデータセンター反対論が共和党に波紋 11/5(木) 1:09 最終更新 ロイター

item.title: World stocks rally as investors expect more political certainty after Democrats' win
item.description: NEW YORK/LONDON, Nov 4 : Global stocks rallied on Wednesday after Democrats seized control of both chambers of Congress in the US midterm elections, providing greater political clarity and reducing the uncertainty that has weighed on markets. Brent crude oil futures were down 9 per cent at $94.50 a barrel

item.content:encoded:

Business

World stocks rally as investors expect more political certainty after Democrats' win

Supporters watch a screen projecting early results as they gather for an Election Night rally for US Senator Jon Ossoff (D-GA), Democratic candidate for re-election, during the US midterm elections in Atlanta, Georgia, US, November 3, 2026. REUTERS/Carlos Barria
